title: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza, medics say, amid new ceasefire push
summary: Reuters reported that Gaza health officials said Israeli strikes killed four Palestinians, while Hamas representatives met mediators in Cairo about efforts to advance a fragile ceasefire.

title: UN says Israel blocks durable shelter materials from entering Gaza
